blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine men’s gymnastics squad led by the dynamic duo of Carlos and Karl Eldrew Yulo placed sixth in the Asian Games 2026 artistic gymnastics team final Wednesday at Nagoya General Gymnasium. Team Philippines, also composed of Justin Ace De Leon, Zachary Nuñez and Miguel Besana, finished sixth among eight squads with 227.359 points.
